channel.title: The San Bernardino Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Bernardino Sun (sbsun.com)

item.title: Novartis settles with Henrietta Lacks’ estate over use of her ‘stolen’ cells to advance medicine
item.description: The agreement was finalized in federal court this month, but details aren’t public.

item.title: Lookout in OC ‘honor roll murder’ case wants his conviction overturned
item.description: Kirn Young Kim -- who was 16 at the time of the killing and became a model prisoner before his parole -- asks that his conviction be overturned after changes to state law.

item.title: Deposed Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro asks judge to toss out indictment against him
item.description: Maduro's attorney says the U.S. government violated his client’s due process rights by blocking funds.

item.title: Make-A-Wish Foundation plans Trailblaze Challenge fundraiser in Joshua Tree National Park
item.description: Here's how to register for the March 6-8 event that benefits children with critical illnesses.

item.title: Seven Inland boys wrestlers advance to the quarterfinals at CIF State Championships
item.description: North's Coby Merrill is among the quarterfinalists, as he seeks a second consecutive state championship.

item.title: Lakers don’t dwell on late collapse against Magic ahead of 2-game trip
item.description: Speaking before Thursday’s game, Coach JJ Redick says the ebbs and flows of an 82-game regular season mean there’s no need to “belabor” every defeat, no matter how frustrating it is.

item.title: Closure is Moreno Valley Mall managers’ fault, city officials say at meeting
item.description: A mall official disputes city's version of events as business owners tell council members that the shutdown is hurting business.

item.title: Lakers can’t slow depleted Suns, lose on last-second 3-pointer
item.description: Luka Doncic has 41 points and the Lakers erase a 12-point deficit late, but Royce O’Neale makes a 3-pointer with 0.9 seconds remaining – the Suns’ 22nd 3 of the night – to hand them a 113-110 defeat.

item.title: Short-handed Clippers can’t outlast Anthony Edwards, Timberwolves
item.description: The Clippers, playing without Kawhi Leonard and John Collins, take a lead into the fourth quarter, but Edwards (31 points) buries a step-back 3-pointer with 42.9 seconds left to help Minnesota hold them off, 94-88.

item.title: Struggling Kings routed by Oilers for 5th straight loss
item.description: One night after surrendering five goals in the third period of a loss to Vegas, they are humiliated by their postseason nemesis, 8-1, as the fan ire directed at Coach Jim Hiller reaches a new volume.
